League|2027–28]]'' | updated = 24 August 2026 }} The '''2026–27 Swiss Challenge League''' (referred to as the '''Dieci Challenge League''' for sponsoring reasons) is the 129th season of the [[Swiss Challenge League|second tier of competitive football in Switzerland]] and the 24th season under its current name. ==Teams== On 23 May 2026, [[SC Kriens|Kriens]] returned to the [[Swiss Challenge League|Challenge League]] after a 4-year absence.{{cite web|url=https://www.kicker.de/kriens-macht-den-aufstieg-in-die-challenge-league-perfekt-1222256/artikel|title=Kriens macht den Aufstieg in die Challenge League perfekt|publisher=[[Kicker (magazine)|Kicker]]|date=23 May 2026|access-date=7 August 2026}} On 12 May 2026, [[FC Winterthur|Winterthur]], relegated from the [[Swiss Super League|Super League]], returned to the second series after a 4-year absence.{{cite web|url=https://www.srf.ch/sport/fussball/super-league/abstieg-nach-4-jahren-wundersame-winterthurer-rettung-bleibt-diesmal-aus|title=Wundersame Winterthurer Rettung bleibt diesmal aus|publisher=[[Kicker (magazine)|Kicker]]|date=12 May 2026|access-date=7 August 2026}} They replace last season's Challenge League champions [[FC Vaduz|Vaduz]], who returned to the top flight after a 5-year absence, and [[AC Bellinzona|Bellinzona]], who were relegated to the [[Swiss Promotion League]] after 4 seasons in the Challenge League.{{cite web|url=https://sfl.ch/de/articles/so-stieg-der-fc-vaduz-wieder-in-die-brack-super-league-auf|title=So stieg der FC Vaduz wieder in die Brack Super League auf|publisher=Swiss Football League|date=28
